topic: Fixing the Mall Analytics traffic feature
summary_markdown: The conversation addresses a specific feature within Mall Analytics that tracks foot traffic for various stores located in malls (previously implemented for clients like JCDecaux UK, CityMedia, and AFA). Currently, this feature is only functional for the J&J store at AFA Bryggen Cluster. The existing implementation has known bugs, specifically failing to display unique user counts. There was a discussion regarding whether to fix or remove the feature. It was decided that the feature must be fixed because it is still being used in sales efforts.
decisions: The Mall Analytics traffic tracking feature needs to be fixed.
action_items: Someone (Sasha) needs to fix the existing analytics feature.
